box.name: Box breathing
box.about: Four counts in, hold, out, hold. It steadies your heart rate and clears your head. Pilots and athletes use it before big moments.
done: Steady and clear. You've got this exam, ne~
Calm mind, sharp mind. Go show them what you know~
See? Your breath listens to you. Good luck, kon!

478.name: 4-7-8 breathing
478.about: In for 4, hold for 7, a long sigh out for 8. The long exhale tells your body it's safe to rest. Lie down if you like.
done: Soft and sleepy now... goodnight. I'll keep watch, kon~
Let the day go. Tomorrow-you will be glad you rested~

calm.name: Slow breathing
calm.about: Five in, five out: about six slow breaths a minute. A gentle reset between study blocks.
done: Nice and slow. Ready when you are~
Mm, that felt good. Back to it, gently~

sigh.name: Calming sigh
sigh.about: Two breaths in through the nose (a deep one, then a little top-up sip), then one long, slow breath out. The fastest way to settle a racing heart.

top: one small sip of air on top

GROUNDING: Look around slowly. Name five things, out loud or in your head.
Your feet on the floor, the chair, your sleeves, the air on your face.
Near and far. The hum of the PC counts.
Or two smells you like, if nothing is around.
Then take one slow breath. You're here, and you're okay.
